text: The seasonal flu shot cannot give you the flu.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.questionWording: The seasonal flu shot distributed in the US cannot give you flu. (True / False / Not sure)
room.note: VERIFY before shipping: one researcher placed the 54/29/16 breakdown in the Jan 10–16, 2023 wave (n=1,657; item base 1,641), the judge placed it in the Oct 5–12, 2023 wave (n≈1,559). Settle the wave, dates and n against the ASAPH toplines (W12 vs W13) before verifying.

truthSource.label: CDC, Misconceptions about seasonal flu and flu vaccines
truthSource.oneLine: Flu shots contain inactivated virus or no virus at all, so they cannot cause influenza infection.
